subject: Re: Sthenos x Encord - September catch up + pricing clarification
text:
Hi Yianni,

Apologies for the late response and thanks for the update and for scheduling the placeholder for early September; that timing works well for us. We also appreciate the suggestion to use that session to align on the trial scope and success criteria; that will be very helpful as we prepare real data for evaluation. No guarantees we will have them available by then. Fingers crossed!

In the meantime, while we are continuing internal planning, we wanted to briefly ask for some clarification regarding your pricing model. In particular, could you please let us know how Encord typically structures pricing for the platform (e.g. subscription-based, usage/credit-based per annotation, or hybrid models), and whether there are standard tiers or volume-based considerations we should be aware of?

This is purely for internal budgeting and decision-making purposes ahead of the trial. We will, of course, proceed with the evaluation regardless of the pricing structure, as we are primarily focused on assessing technical fit and performance with our dataset.

For context, I have cc’d Dimos Christopoulos, Principal Data Scientist and Engineering Manager at Stenos AI, who is also involved in the technical evaluation and trial planning on our side.

No need for detailed figures at this stage; even a high-level overview of your commercial model would be very helpful for us to plan accordingly.

Looking forward to continuing the discussion in September.

Kind regards,

Ioannis

P.S. I’m afraid I’ve never actually been to Milos or Paros, so I don’t have any taverna recommendations to share;  I’ll have to fix that gap in my Mediterranean experience soon!
